description: Single-canonical-authority registry. Each entry declares the ONE authoritative artifact for a semantic domain, the legacy definitions it supersedes, and the derived projections it generates. This is data, not code: tools/authority/check_authority.py reads it and enforces the invariant that no semantic domain has more than one authority.

authorities.note: Canonical WorkRequest IR (3-layer, 11-state). Splits intent vs event-derived state: `metadata.mode` is the 3-layer IR mode (ir_layer: INTENT/BINDING/EXECUTION-BOUND), while `execution_state` + `status` are event-derived runtime state (execution_state/execution_status). .agents/schema/work_request.schema.json is the pre-WRP draft and is superseded; schemas/ontology/core/work-request.jsonld is the JSON-LD graph form.
WRP lifecycle event envelope (additive-only versioning). schemas/ontology/core/event.jsonld is the JSON-LD graph form.
WRP 11-state lifecycle and adjacency matrix. Distinct from the CCNF PGV phase machine (go/wrp/ccnf-ref/.tools/pgv.state_machine.json), which governs CCNF phases, not WR status.
Pure PEB domain types (no framework/db imports). The TypeSpec-generated client models are a projection; TypeSpec provenance reconciliation is tracked separately.
Go CCNF reference is the authority oracle. The Rust ccnf-verifier is the cross-language conformance projection.

Canonical graph type definition. The SQL projection is regenerated from it. GraphSnapshot/VectorSnapshot (knowledge-graph.jsonld, extensions/vector-snapshot.jsonld) and graph-data backups (graph/nexus-knowledge-graph.json.bak/.pre-rebuild) are GENERATED PROJECTIONS — point-in-time artifacts that never carry canonical authority.
